👋 Welcome to Logo Block Race!

How To Play:
🌟 Step on the right logo!
🏆 Reach the end to earn wins!
⚔️ Buy gears, trails, effects to become better!
🌟 Hatch and upgrade rare pets!

💎 Codes: "RELEASE"!

📕 We're finally back! Enjoy racing logos with your friends! Don't forget to like + favorite!
